details.question: 2011年11月的商品正向交易金额是多少
details.model_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_amount), 2) AS product_gross_amount
FROM analytics.transactions
WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
  AND include_product_sales = TRUE
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date = '2011-11-01'
LIMIT 100;

details.question: 2011年11月取消金额占正向金额的比例是多少
details.model_sql:
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_sales), 2) AS product_gross_amount,
    ROUND(-SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_cancellations), 2) AS product_cancel_amount,
    ROUND(
        ((-SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_cancellations)) / NULLIF(SUM(line_amount) FILTER (WHERE include_product_sales), 0)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS cancel_ratio
FROM analytics.transactions
WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
AND DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date = '2011-11-01'
LIMIT 100

details.question: 2011年11月金额最高的10个客户占全部正向金额的比例
details.model_sql:
WITH top10_cust_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS customer_sales
    FROM analytics.transactions
    WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
      AND include_product_sales = TRUE
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date = '2011-11-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY customer_sales DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
total_all_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM analytics.transactions
    WHERE source_batch = '20260917T121850_455264Z'
      AND include_product_sales = TRUE
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date = '2011-11-01'
)
SELECT ROUND((SUM(t1.customer_sales) / t2.total_sales * 100)::numeric, 2) AS top10_customer_sales_ratio
FROM top10_cust_sales t1
CROSS JOIN total_all_sales t2;
